# Third-party packages

The runtime dependencies only: what the Docker image installs (`uv sync --frozen --no-dev`) and what the page depends on (`dependencies` in `web/package.json`), with everything they pull in. Development tools, the optional `browser` extra and the test suites are left out. The page's list is the lockfile's closure; the built bundle includes less, because Vite drops what the page never imports.

Licences come from each Python package's installed metadata and from `package-lock.json`. Every licence must be one of `ALLOWED_LICENCES` in `scripts/gen_docs.py`; the test fails on any other.
